overview_description.description:
Belvo is the open finance API platform that enables users to connect their accounts to an app. The platform lets financial innovators to access and interpret data from their end-users in an easy and scalable way.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Mexico City.

about_short_description.short_description: Belvo is the open finance API platform that enables users to connect their accounts to an app.

product.name: Belvo Open Finance API Platform
product.description: An API-based infrastructure platform for connecting applications to financial accounts, accessing permissioned data, interpreting financial activity, and initiating account-to-account payments in Latin America.

product.name: Financial Data Aggregation
product.description: APIs for accessing permissioned banking, employment, and fiscal information from connected financial institutions and public-sector sources.

identifier.value: Financial Data Enrichment and Risk Insights

product.name: Financial Data Enrichment and Risk Insights
product.description: Data-processing services that categorize transactions and generate income, recurring-expense, employment, and risk insights from connected financial data.

product.name: Account-to-Account Payments
product.description: Payment initiation services for accepting bank-to-bank payments, recurring collections, top-ups, and other account-based transfers through regional payment rails.

product.name: Account Verification
product.description: Services for validating account ownership and matching banking details with customer identity information to reduce payment, onboarding, and fraud risks.

product.name: Belvo Connect and Operations Tools
product.description: Self-service tools for integrating and managing Belvo, including account-connection interfaces, no-code launch options, analytics, and payment administration.
